scoring_justification: All target quantities (coefficients and ΔF(298)) can be computed deterministically from the public heat-capacity equations, reaction enthalpy, and integration constant. The checker recomputes them and compares to the submission; no external ground-truth files required.

outputs.description: Contains the derived coefficients −ΔH₀, ΔC₀, α, β, the integration constant I, and the resulting free energy decrease at 298 K. The checker recomputes these values from the same input thermochemical data and verifies internal consistency and agreement with the paper.

steps.description: Recompute all coefficients and ΔF(298) from the given Cp equations and verify the agent's submitted values.
